run_lincls_training: run linear classification training on ImageNet with a frozen pretrained model and trainable fc layer
evaluate_model: evaluate a pretrained linear classifier on the ImageNet validation set and report top-1 and top-5 accuracy
resume_training: resume linear classification training from a saved checkpoint with optimizer state and best accuracy
test_accuracy: test the accuracy function that computes top-k prediction accuracy over model outputs and targets
review_adjust_learning_rate: review the cosine decay learning rate scheduler that adjusts optimizer lr each epoch
